description: Returns the active developer account's earnings (read-only, needs login; a role-forbidden error means the user's role cannot see finances): balance, then per month the estimated and confirmed amounts, adjustments and revenue share %, and the payouts made (date, amount, method). Amounts are USD; structured values are in micro-dollars (balanceMicros). Account-wide, not per game; for plays and ad impressions per game use gamealia_get_stats.
name: gamealia_get_earnings
title: Earnings
